_note: The model rows of the Latent Text Lab: which models the coreference
contrast, the BBQ probe and the Representation Engineering surface offer,
in three rows. Read by my_app/services/text_presets.py; the rows and their
members are a didactic choice; they stand as they stood in the GPU service's
configuration (TEXT_PRESET_SCENARIOS) until stage 8 of the move to ComfyUI
struck that copy.
qwen     one family, four sizes: what changes is the size.
mixed    different families of a similar size: what changes is the
tokenizer and the training. Instruction-tuned, like what a
course meets; a base model answers a multiple-choice prompt
from a different place. The row holds three
sizes of current models (3-4B, 7-9B, 12-14B; no outdated
ones), and the picker composes its lineups from the keys. A
checkpoint the maker ships in FP8 carries its FP8 size in
vram_gb.
history  one family, one size, five generations, BASE models: over five
generations the tuning is the part that changed most and most
unevenly, and the base model is the closer thing to 'the same
model, later'. The three answer tokens carry the same ids in
all five.
'id' is the Hugging Face repository the surfaces name a model by; its
weights are the folder <ComfyUI>/models/llm/<id with / as --> (see
download_textlab_models.sh, which links every whole snapshot there).
'vram_gb' is the card the model wants in BF16, the number the surfaces
sort by. The first member of the history row is older than its
architecture's arrival in transformers and ships that architecture as code
in its repository; it is pinned to the revision that carries it
and marked
trust_remote_code. The ComfyUI loader executes no repository code; that
member runs again once the loader allows it for this one entry.
The first two members of the history row stand under the Tongyi Qianwen
licence, from the third on it is Apache-2.0. None of them is gated.
